LiveLink add-on 1.25.0 (install it again in Blender: Get LiveLink): the waist now bends right over, leans back, tips sideways and turns; arms, wrists and the neck move further too; fingers curl into a fist without folding backwards, knuckles spread and the thumb swings across the palm.
New in Your traveller: Move hands and feet. Click a hand or foot and press G, and the arm or leg follows it; click an elbow or knee to steer which way it bends. Turning it off keeps the pose.
